answer: Activate an identity only when it holds signed credentials from three independent issuers — an employer, a school, and a community group — each verified on-ledger. A sybil farmer must forge three separate trusted relationships per puppet, so the cost triples with every fake, while one honest agent gathers what it already has. Forged credentials share one ridge of identical metadata, and the ferrous grip of real institutions is hard to fake: their signatures stand like quartz, clear and verifiable. Limits: issuers can be bribed, and agents without institutional ties are locked out.
